title: Bulanci master-pack asset registry
description: Single source of truth for named master-pack resources. Read by the gallery (`serve.py`), the asset-export pipeline (`build_assets.py`), and the typed-handle codegen (`build_typed_handles.py`).

scripts.description: Master-pack scripts that act as gallery categories. Keyed by the script's decimal ID (e.g. `"65843"`).

assets.description: Per-resource metadata. Keyed by the hex-padded resource ID (`"0x000100ae"`).

manual_assets.description: Synthetic assets with no master-pack catalog ID — e.g. composite cursor reticles, hand-baked composition JSON, or pre-extracted artefacts that ship under a custom path. Each entry must declare its `class` and `source` path explicitly because the catalog can't tell us either. Listed as an array (not an object) because there's no natural key — slugs alone are the identifier.

folders.description: Sparse folder-level metadata. Only folders that need notes appear here. Folders are derived from each asset's `folder` field; this map is purely for attaching descriptions.

slug.description: Canonical name. Becomes the asset's identifier in the typed-handle codegen and the file name in `open_bulanci/assets/`.

folder.description: Forward-slash separated project folder, e.g. `menu/widgets/radio`. Used by the gallery folder tree and by the typed-handle codegen (each segment becomes a Rust module).

ship.description: When true, the asset pipeline copies / transcodes this resource into `open_bulanci/assets/`.

samples.description: AudioBank only — per-sample slugs keyed by sample index. Each entry is exported as `audio/<sample-slug>.wav` after 22050 -> 48000 Hz polyphase resampling.

source.description: Path inside `open_bulanci/assets/` (relative). Used as-is by the typed-handle codegen and by the runtime VFS lookup.

notes.description: Shown in the gallery folder tree + asset detail panel.
